articles.articleTitle: What the colour of a rose says
articles.articleContent: Red is for love, pink for thanks and admiration. White suits weddings and sympathy, yellow is for friendship, and peach says you are glad to know someone. Not sure? A mixed bouquet says a little of everything.

articles.articleTitle: How to keep cut flowers fresh for a week
articles.articleContent: Cut the stems at an angle, strip the leaves that would sit under water, and use a clean vase. Change the water every two days and trim the stems again. Keep the bouquet away from fruit, heaters and direct sun.

articles.articleTitle: What is in season in autumn?
articles.articleContent: Dahlias, chrysanthemums, cosmos and the last sunflowers. Autumn bouquets hold well in a cool room. Which autumn flower is your favourite?

articles.articleTitle: A card message in two lines
articles.articleContent: Say what the day is, then one true thing about the person: "Happy birthday, Mina. You make every room brighter." Short and specific beats long and general. You can add the message at checkout.

articles.articleTitle: Four house plants that forgive a missed watering
articles.articleContent: Monstera, peace lily, snake plant and most succulents cope with a dry week. Water when the top of the soil is dry, not by the calendar. A peace lily droops when it is thirsty and stands up again within hours.

articles.articleTitle: Which sweets go well with flowers?
articles.articleContent: Macarons and boxed chocolates travel well all year. On hot days keep the box out of the sun and away from the vase. What would you like to find next to a bouquet?
